description: 2746-Node Polish Energy System Data Of Transmission And Voltage Constraints Contribution To The Formation Of Lmp is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Vaskovskaya Tatiana, Thakurta Priyanko Guha. This is the dataset that is used for the original article: "Contribution of Transmission and Voltage Constraints in the Formation of Locational Marginal Prices" MATPOWER is required. The dataset obtained by MATPOWER ver6.0 tool [1]. Run run_matpower_acopf.m in MATLAB to start AC OPF. Offers should be saved in the MATLAB search path. Coverage: national (PL); the metadata date the deposit to 2017. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
